She holds a small black microphone and addresses the camera. Beside her is a young boy with wet, straight hair wearing a blue and white striped t-shirt. (2) The scene cuts rapidly as the woman interviews four children. They are shown in medium close-ups. The children include the boy in the striped shirt, a boy with darker skin and curly hair in a blue shirt, a young girl with curly hair in a yellow top, and a boy with a short mohawk in a blue shirt. (3) The woman leans into the frame, moving the microphone between herself and the children. The lighting is bright and warm, highlighting the expressions of the children as they answer questions. Yellow text boxes with black text appear periodically at the bottom of the frame to show the questions and their answers. (4) In the concluding segment, the woman is joined by a bearded man wearing a yellow sweatshirt. They are in a close-up shot, laughing and smiling directly at the lens. The background remains the same indoor residential environment with soft artificial lighting.
